title: Odoo connection
description: Save the Odoo server this company imports from. The API key or account password is stored encrypted and is never shown again.

help.title: About the Odoo connection
help.overview: The Odoo connection stores how this company reaches its Odoo server. There is one connection per company; the Odoo import uses it to read data over JSON-RPC from the API server.

sections.title: What to enter
sections.body: Use the same URL, database, and login that work in Odoo.
items: URL is the Odoo address, for example https://your-company.odoo.com. Database is the Odoo database name.
Username is the Odoo login. The secret is an API key (preferred) or that user's password.
The secret is required the first time and stored encrypted. Leave it blank when saving again to keep the stored one.

sections.title: What the connection is used for
items: Only the import reads from Odoo; nothing is ever written back to Odoo.
The import authenticates first, so a wrong URL, database, or secret shows up as an error there.

form.apiKeyPlaceholder: Odoo API key or account password
form.apiKeyHint: Odoo JSON-RPC accepts an API key or the account password for this login.
form.apiKeySetPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the stored secret
form.apiKeySetHint: A secret is already stored. Enter a new API key or password only to replace it.

saveError: Could not save the Odoo connection
loadError: Could not load the Odoo connection
